Requestor & Date.guidance: Name of the person requesting the change and the date.

Category of Change.guidance: Scope, Quality, Requirements, Cost, Schedule, or Documents.

Detailed Description of Proposed Change.guidance: Clear explanation of what needs to be changed.

Justification for Proposed Change.guidance: Reasoning and business value for the change.

Impacts of Change - Scope.guidance: How the change affects project scope.

Impacts of Change - Quality.guidance: How the change affects quality standards.

Impacts of Change - Schedule.guidance: How the change affects the timeline.

Impacts of Change - Cost.guidance: How the change affects the budget.

Impacts of Change - Stakeholder/Document.guidance: Impact on stakeholders and which documents need updates.

Disposition.guidance: Approve, Defer, Reject, and Justification (Filled by CCB).
